title: K.H
html_source:
Koot Hoomi, a mahatma

whose teachings H P Blavatsky used to develop the spiritual understanding of theosophists.

anchor.prefix:
This verily is that. I am the fire upon the altar. I am the sacrificial butter. 

 Dunlop, Judge, the noblest Roman of them all, A.E., Arval, the Name Ineffable, in heaven hight:
